doctrine_note: REFINE. The price curve unlocks exactly the two plays that were stood down on all four days in my blind - direction.flow_conviction_sign_gate and direction.absorption_is_reversal - and on this block they are not one instrument among many, they are THE instrument. Everything below is derived from the realized phase table (sflow, pxchg, vol per phase) crossed with vol_regime n0_net_sigma_10 = 1058, which is the same sigma my blind used. I have NOT touched the immutable blind, any agent file, the coordinator, the brain, or the harness. I ran s103.4 exactly as written including the disclosed incomplete b_share re-point, and I have separated, per day, what is a corrected REASONING call from what is a corrected INPUT - because this block turns out to carry a data defect large enough to invert a sign, and a merge that banks it as forward evidence for a play would be banking a data fix.

cross_cutting_mbo_finding.headline: G21 is ONE mechanism run ten times: a persistent SELL tape (signed flow negative on 8 of 10 sessions) under a record managed-money short, which is either ABSORBED (price up) or DELIVERED (price down). absorb_session alone calls the day sign 9 of 10. That is the read the blind is structurally incapable of making, and it is why the blind's errors stopped pointing one way and started oscillating.

The realized leg traded 34,221 / 37,477 / 44,127. THERE WAS NO THINNING. My 'mechanically explained' third blind finding is withdrawn in full.

finding_1_the_seventh_data_hole.distinct_from_the_S107_six_and_from_my_o: The S107 six were EMPTY blocks - three mechanisms, one indistinguishable null. My blind's squeeze_watch find was a LIVE flag whose deterministic limb was frozen with its price limb, emitting a confident false NEGATIVE. This one is different again: a populated, self-consistent block carrying real numbers from the wrong slice of the session. It passes every completeness assertion because nothing is missing. The detector shape it needs is a RECONCILIATION, not a presence check: assert tape_conditions.n_trades against an independent count of the same session on the same leg, and hard-fail a ratio outside ~[0.95, 1.05]. finding_3_a_derived_magnitude_ruler_and_.ruler: CONVICTION-WEIGHTED VOLUME SHARE. Compute per-phase conviction = sign(sflow) x sign(pxchg); assign each phase's VOLUME to UP or DOWN by whether that phase's conviction verdict points up (absorbed sell, aligned buy) or down (absorbed buy, aligned sell). net_share = up_vol_share - down_vol_share. day_move ~ net_share x n0_net_sigma_10.

finding_3_a_derived_magnitude_ruler_and_.the_override_that_catches_the_failure: NON-DELIVERY GATE: a session whose ALIGNED phases fail to push price beyond the open in their own direction (|extreme in the aligned direction| < ~0.15 x sigma) is a NON-DELIVERY; |day net| < 0.1 sigma regardless of how much flow ran, and the sign is set by the one non-aligned phase. finding_3_a_derived_magnitude_ruler_and_.honesty_label: This ruler is a DECOMPOSITION, not a prediction. It reads realized per-phase pxchg, so a refine can compute it and a blind cannot. Its forward value is that it tells the blind exactly what it needs to estimate: not the flow (it has that) but WHICH PHASES WILL ABSORB. I am not claiming the blind can run it. On my four days the ruler plus the non-delivery gate produces 490/1058/-1058/non-delivery against realized 490/970/-970/+70, on one parameter (sigma) that was already in the state.
finding_3_a_derived_magnitude_ruler_and_.symmetry_check: 0616 and 0617 are both UNANIMOUS-conviction sessions with opposite signs, and I sized both at the same 0.89-0.90 sigma under-claim. Realized was 0.92 sigma both times. Treating the up day and the down day by one identical rule is the point - it is the only way to know the ruler is not a lean in disguise.

finding_4_a_third_instance_of_the_unreac.statement: structure.covering_extension_distribution_flip - the play that OWNS 20260617 - requires 'cum high ~>+2000 vs block anchor AND age >=5'. G21's ENTIRE cum_from_anchor range is -1410 to +340. The play could not fire on its stated threshold on any day of this block, on either arm.
finding_4_a_third_instance_of_the_unreac.why_the_threshold_is_in_the_wrong_coordi: The extension that matters is the COVERING RUN's own extension, measured from the swing origin, not from the block anchor. G21's covering run goes from the 0611 cum trough -1410 to the 0616 close +340 = a +1750 four-session run - which is squarely the regime the play describes. A block whose anchor happens to sit ABOVE the rally's origin can never reach +2000 no matter how extended the rally gets. This is the same failure shape as the two I flagged in the blind: selector.divergence_resolution arm (a)'s HDD>=16.4 bar, unreachable in June by construction (block max gw-HDD 0.94), and the absolute 0.50 b_share bar carried by three unrepointed sign plays.
finding_4_a_third_instance_of_the_unreac.consistency_with_the_play_s_own_retired_: The play has ALREADY retired one label-vs-realized-cum assumption ('the age arm must read REGIME AGE FROM REALIZED CUM'). This is the exact same correction applied to the other arm: read EXTENSION from realized cum relative to the swing ORIGIN, not to the block anchor. It is one coordinate change, not a new play.
finding_4_a_third_instance_of_the_unreac.falsifiable_and_cheap: Re-score the flip's fires and declines on anchor-cum vs origin-cum across G17-G21 and see which coordinate carries the direction. I am proposing no number and I have edited nothing.
finding_4_a_third_instance_of_the_unreac.three_for_three: Three thresholds now measured as unreachable-by-construction in a block they were meant to govern, all fitted in one block's coordinate system and applied in another's. That is a doctrinal pattern, not three coincidences: a threshold whose units are block-relative must be re-expressed in regime-relative units before it is merged.

finding_5_the_turn_stack_has_no_expiry_a.statement: selector.midblock_right_the_ship and structure.accumulation_arm_turn license a turn call from a BUILDING stack. Neither carries an EXPIRY. I ran the same stack for a fifth consecutive session on 20260617 after it had already produced its turn and paid out three consecutive up sessions (0612 +620, 0615 +160 day-move / +910 net, 0616 +970).
finding_5_the_turn_stack_has_no_expiry_a.general_form: An accumulation / turn stack is a ONE-SHOT LICENCE and it is EXPENDED by the turn it predicted. Once realized cum has crossed to the covering side, the identical stack stops being evidence for continuation and becomes evidence for exhaustion. This is the exact symmetry of the G19 finding that covering-self-limiting was non-falsifiable toward DOWN; here the accumulation arm was non-falsifiable toward UP.
finding_5_the_turn_stack_has_no_expiry_a.the_brain_already_has_this_rule_on_the_w: daytype.covering_giveback_self_limiting states it verbatim - 'a covering give-back is a ONE-SHOT (1-2 session) event, NOT a standing bias ... once realized, revert to the chain/state default UNLESS a FRESH crowding stack rebuilt since. A still-extreme-but-NOT-worsening COT is spent fuel.' But its target is friday_direction and its scope is the second weekend-feeding day. The identical failure lives on core Tue/Wed, which is my entire lens, and there is nothing there to stop it.
finding_5_the_turn_stack_has_no_expiry_a.proposal_shape_only: Extend covering_giveback_self_limiting's scope from friday_direction to ANY day-class, keyed on realized cum having crossed to the covering side rather than on the weekend seam. Falsifiable: re-score every midblock_right_the_ship / accumulation_arm_turn fire in G17-G21 against whether the stack had already delivered, and see whether the post-delivery fires are net negative. Not proposing a merge; my brain is untouched.
finding_5_the_turn_stack_has_no_expiry_a.caveat_on_this_block_s_COT_arm: G21's COT was still WORSENING into week 2 (net -114,854 -> -122,617, shorts +9,054, 1y pctile 4.72 -> 2.83), so the 'fresh fuel' test as literally written would have PASSED on 0617 and re-licensed the stack. That is the sharper version of the finding: worsening COT was true and the stack still had to expire, because what expired it was the REALIZED CUM crossing, not the positioning. Cum, not COT, is the expiry clock.

evidence_used: structure.covering_extension_distribution_flip - THE OWNER. Its arm (b) reads verbatim: 'Maximally extended with the absorption tell ITSELF reversed (aligned-down delivery, or big BUY absorbed under falling price): the identical signature = late chasers absorbed = DISTRIBUTION DOWN.' 0616's exit state is exactly that - last_hour_dir -1 with last_hour_signed_flow +1, buy flow absorbed under a falling price, at close_off_low_frac 0.90, i.e. at the TOP of the range.

The play's explicit PRE-WARNING arm fires by name: 'a rally day whose SESSION conviction is negative (sflow opposite the day's price) is a terminal-squeeze signature - kill the covering-UP prior for the next extended session.' 0616's session conviction = sign(-5687) x sign(+960) = NEGATIVE. The pre-warning is not an inference here, it is the play reading its own trigger off the prior session.

(1) INPUT, the largest share: my stated primary derivation was 'the D-1 sell is decaying,' computed on a tape_conditions series that carried -624 against a realized -5687 and a decaying shape against an accelerating one. On the corrected series the D-1 trade tilt - which the shared doctrine puts DIRECTION on by default - is emphatically SELL, and the accumulation stack's week-2 leg is not even verifiable, so the blind's up-case largely dissolves without any price at all. Corrected input alone probably recovers the SIGN. (2) HANDOFF, second: covering_extension_distribution_flip needs cum_from_anchor carried across the boundary, and in the blind I named it by hand as 'the play most likely to be RIGHT and most completely unavailable ... if the realized cum has run strongly positive into 0617, this play would flip my sign, and I cannot see it.' It had. It does. That is a handoff hole, not a reasoning failure, and it is precisely what round 2 exists to close. (3) REASONING, smallest but real and entirely mine: running a turn stack for a fifth session after it had already produced three up days. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE MERGE: 0617 is NOT clean forward evidence that covering_extension_distribution_flip is blind-available. It is a second-block confirmation of the play as a REFINE mechanism (n=3 G19 -> n=4), and its blind-side test has to come from a group whose tape_conditions reconciles.

summary.how_the_magnitudes_were_derived: ONE ruler on three days - conviction-weighted volume share x n0_net_sigma_10 (1058, the same sigma the blind was served) - with an identical 0.10-0.11 sigma honest under-claim applied to both the largest up day and the largest down day so the treatment is symmetric. The fourth day (0609) is the ruler's one in-block failure and is sized by the non-delivery gate instead, which is stated openly rather than buried. No number below is read off net_usd; every one follows from the phase table plus sigma.

verdict_on_the_up_lean_question.on_my_days_it_is_neither: My four blind days summed -10 against a realized +560. I did not carry an up-lean - I carried NO lean, and the flatness was itself a hedge. The block-level +740 blind cum is not visible on my quarter of the block.
verdict_on_the_up_lean_question.the_real_residual_is_timidity_not_bias: Mean |blind| across my four days is 148. Mean |actual| is 625. The blind called 24% of the available move. On the three days where the causal read is decisive it emitted -130 / +180 / +110 against realized +490 / +970 / -970. It is not leaning the wrong way; it is refusing to size.
verdict_on_the_up_lean_question.the_mechanism_of_the_timidity: It is a direct consequence of the fix. Removing a structural down-gate did not install an up-gate - it removed the thing that was manufacturing conviction. What is left is a blind that can see the flow but not whether the flow will be absorbed, and on this block that single unknown IS the sign on 9 of 10 days. Faced with a coin it cannot call, it hedges to a fifth of sigma. That is why the errors de-correlated (which is the fix working) without shrinking (which is the next problem).
verdict_on_the_up_lean_question.so_the_answer: Not an over-correction, and not yet a real read. On my days the up-lean does not exist; what exists is a no-lean. The next problem is not calibrating a lean, it is giving the blind a decision-time proxy for ABSORPTION. flow.price_free_absorption_proxy is the only instrument currently in that slot and this block shows it at half scope with one of its two G21 fires standing on a corrupt input.
verdict_on_the_up_lean_question.the_uncomfortable_counterfactual_address: The framing notes that a blind still carrying the old down lean would have drifted -480, better than the +960 we got. On my four days that is arithmetic, not evidence: a persistent down lean would have called 0610 and 0616 wrong by more (-490 and -970 of additional error) and 0617 right by luck. A lean that scores by being wrong on the two absorbed-sell days is not a read; it is a coin that happened to land. The forward-curve number flatters it for the same reason the hit-rate flattered G20.

Did NOT claim any reactive tail. 0610's +1120 peak, 0616's +1100 peak and 0617's -1320 low are all excursions the sessions gave back, and all three of my emitted numbers sit inside the confirmed base.

Did NOT re-point structure.accumulation_arm_turn, midweek.giveback_exhaustion_reversal_recognition, or selector.midblock_right_the_ship to the two-sided b_share series, and did NOT touch the covering_extension_distribution_flip threshold. Ran s103.4 exactly as written per Greg's decision that G21 runs WHOLE on s103.4; conflicts reported, brain untouched.
Did NOT propose a number for the extension threshold or for a summer CDD band-authority bar. Both need measurement across blocks, not assumption.
Did NOT credit the squeeze_watch demand-channel demotion on 0616/0617. It shrank a wrong-signed number on one day and was irrelevant on the other.

Did NOT bank 0616 as a hit. The sign agreed with my blind and the precondition it fired on was inverted; a right answer from a false premise is a coincidence and recording it as forward evidence would corrupt the play.
summary.single_most_important_thing_for_the_post: tape_conditions - the declared never_masked block that is the blind's only open-time flow channel - is byte-exact for week 1 and a sign-flipping 18-60% partial for week 2, and it passes state_health because nothing is missing. It manufactured a false 'delivery-window thinning' mechanism complete with three corroborating markers, crushed both my week-2 magnitudes, and supplied the inverted premise that carried my 0617 sign. Until it reconciles, G21's week 2 cannot score any blind-side play in either direction. The check it needs is a RECONCILIATION against an independent count of the same session on the same leg, not another presence assertion.
